pull_request.title: Calorimeter: summarize EM findings in an eight-page review
pull_request.head: codex/emcal-findings-report
pull_request.body:
Summarizes the EM calorimeter findings in an eight-page review, with editable sources, pinned evidence and standalone SVG controls under `docs/publication/emcal-findings/`.

The PDF and four-series SVG compare ODD, nODD Si-W, physically staggered Si-W and LAr400. Three matched 10k saved-hit samples use 0.05-wide |eta| bins, all events/zeros and 1000 shared whole-primary bootstrap replicates (seed 13001000). ODD remains explicitly limited to its retained 20 GeV/c, fixed-phi, 200-event reference markers at eta 0/1/2. The observable is SD(H/Etrue)/mean(H/Etrue), a raw-response width proxy, not intrinsic fixed-energy resolution.

Addresses [the human review comment](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/145#issuecomment-6951330371), retaining the dated 17 November LAr400 working-baseline selection and the distinction from the 800 mm combined-export integration control. Connected services, collar/FCAL fit, readout-boundary correction and engineering qualification remain open. Later geometry studies retain their own dated source records; this report is not relabelled as validation of another model.

The two additional, equal-width standalone SVGs retain the three nODD width curves and show underlying response distributions in |eta| bands [0,1), [1,2), [2,3]. All 10,000 matched primaries, zeros and tails remain in their statistics. Independent PhysVal/PubDoc reviews and their exact source revisions are preserved.

Merge readiness, 18 November: ordinarily incorporates current main `ea311d72e722e00958a8cb76752895eae35a6fc6`, including merged #147, resolving only project/inventory conflicts. The previously incorporated #143/#144/#146 dependency history and receipts remain intact. All 16 report files, including the PDF and SVGs, are byte-identical to the previous PR head `d8fd70a7ffe08b5df913a17c3fe950b1a835e428`. No simulation, geometry, calibration or scientific result changes. This PR remains ready; no merge into main is performed.

Exact available direct-work accounting:

| Canonical task | Distinct turns | Input | Output | Total |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Original report | 6 | 33,061,938 | 92,055 | 33,153,993 |
| Review response | 5 | 43,513,181 | 120,976 | 43,634,157 |
| Standalone SVGs / PNG preview | 3 | 10,359,262 | 65,597 | 10,424,859 |
| Total | 14 | 86,934,381 | 278,628 | 87,213,009 |

Five newly finalized coordinator turns add 56,697,291 observed tokens to their original canonical owners. Nine specialist records are unchanged; thread/turn uniqueness prevents double counting. Earlier simulation/dependency work retains its separate canonical owners. Cached input and reasoning output are subsets. The active preparation turn is unfinalized and explicitly unavailable, never estimated. Usage receipts and PR interaction records feed the existing token Pages build after merge.

Validation: 18 response-control tests; frozen-report guard; PDF/builder, historical input, data/producer and all three SVG hashes; project/session/inventory checks; retained interaction ledgers; token validation and preview. Hosted CI runs on the published head; use the merge box for its final current-head result.

[Merge/accounting record](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/emcal-findings-report/logs/codex/SESSION-2026-11-18-pr145-merge-accounting.md) · [Exact parent usage receipt](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/emcal-findings-report/logs/usage/USAGE-2026-11-18-pr145-parent-closure.json)
